name: building plot
definition: a parcel of land sold to build on, with or without planning permission.

name: arable land
definition: land used or sold for growing field crops such as cereals, roots or oilseeds.

name: grazing land
definition: pasture, paddock or meadow held for livestock or horses.

name: orchard
definition: land planted with fruit or nut trees.

name: vineyard
definition: land planted with grape vines.

name: woodland
definition: land under trees, whether managed for timber, amenity or conservation (`managed_for`).

name: lake
definition: a body of water, pond, fishery or wetland held as the property.

name: mixed holding
definition: a holding with no single principal use (no one use covers more than half the area, or areas are not given and several uses are combined with none sold as the main one); area (`plot_area`) and enterprises (`enterprises`) are attributes.

name: detached house
definition: a whole house standing free of neighbours; a factory-built home on a permanent foundation and a unit that meets the dwelling test are filed here.

name: semi-detached house
definition: a house joined to one neighbour on one side.

name: terraced house
definition: a house in a row, joined to neighbours on both sides or, at the end of the row, on one side.

name: flat
definition: one dwelling unit on a single level inside a larger building.

name: maisonette
definition: one dwelling unit whose rooms are on two or more full levels inside a larger building.

name: multi-unit residential building
definition: a whole building of two or more dwellings held as one object.

name: moored houseboat
definition: a hull without its own propulsion and steering, made to stay moored as a dwelling.

name: tiny house on wheels
definition: a small dwelling built on a trailer chassis, however often it is towed.

name: park model
definition: a single-section dwelling or cabin built on an RV trailer chassis and sold as a park model RV.

name: static caravan
definition: a home made as one section on a chassis, whatever its width, kept on one pitch and not built as a park model RV.

name: lodge or park home
definition: a factory-built home made as two or more sections joined on the pitch (twin-unit), for holiday or residential use.

name: floating home
definition: a dwelling on a float or hull moored in a slip, connected to shore utilities, not made to navigate.

name: garage
definition: an enclosed building for vehicles, attached or freestanding.

name: carport
definition: a roofed, open-sided shelter for vehicles.

name: cart shed
definition: an open-fronted farm building for carts and farm machinery.

name: boathouse
definition: a building for keeping boats, on or beside water.

name: garden shed
definition: a small outbuilding for tools and garden storage that a person can enter.

name: workshop
definition: a building made for repair or craft work, domestic or commercial.

name: shipping container (kept in place)
definition: a shipping container fixed on a site as a store or room.

name: summerhouse
definition: a garden building for sitting and relaxing in.

name: garden office
definition: an insulated garden building made to work in.

name: garden log cabin
definition: a log-walled garden building made as a general room or retreat, not fitted for one purpose.

name: garden bar
definition: a garden building fitted as a bar, with a bar counter or serving hatch, whatever its walls.

name: sauna cabin
definition: a sauna that stands as a building.

name: barn
definition: a large farm building with an open interior for hay, grain, machinery or loose-housed livestock.

name: stable block
definition: a building whose floor is laid out mainly as stalls or loose boxes, even when sold as a horse barn or built with a hay loft or tack room.

name: granary
definition: a building for storing grain that a person can stand in.

name: dovecote
definition: a building for housing doves or pigeons that a person can enter.

name: gazebo
definition: a freestanding, open-sided structure with a roof (boarded, shingled, tiled or a fixed canopy).

name: pergola
definition: an open frame of posts and beams or rafters whose top is open, slatted or planted.

name: decking
definition: a raised timber or composite platform built in place, including one built for a tent, yurt or tipi.

name: patio
definition: a laid paved or hard surface outside a building.

name: jetty or pontoon
definition: a fixed or floating structure for mooring or access over water, held as a structure (not a mooring right).

name: in-ground swimming pool
definition: a swimming pool built into the ground.

name: office building
definition: a building made for offices.

name: shop
definition: a building made for retail trade.

name: warehouse
definition: a building made for storing goods in bulk.

name: industrial unit
definition: a building made for producing goods (manufacturing, processing, assembly).

name: hotel
definition: a building made for letting rooms to guests.

name: ground burial plot
definition: an in-ground grave space for a casket, of single, companion or family capacity.

name: cremation (urn) plot
definition: an in-ground plot for cremated remains.

name: lawn crypt
definition: an underground pre-built vault set in a lawn section.

name: mausoleum crypt
definition: an above-ground chamber for a casket inside a community mausoleum.

name: private mausoleum
definition: a freestanding building holding crypts for one family.

name: columbarium niche
definition: a compartment in a wall, stele or building for an urn.

name: green burial plot
definition: one person's or one family's own grave space in a natural setting, including one of several sites at a shared tree.

name: communal grave space [goshi-bo, 合祀墓]
definition: a shared burial space where the remains of many people are placed together, with no separate site for each.
